newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIA'S KOELLERER OUT UNTIL JANUARY.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-AUSTRIA'S KOELLERER OUT UNTIL JANUARY.

text.p: Austrian ski racer Karin Koellerer will be out of action until January after sustaining a bad knee injury in last week's World Cup giant slalom in Park City, Utah.

"Doctors believe I can be back on the slopes in four weeks. I hope I can be back on the World Cup for the races in Zwiesel (Germany, on January 18 and 19)," Koellerer said from her hospital bed in Schruns, Austria, on Monday.

Koellerer, 26, was flown home after tearing left knee ligaments during Thursday's race and underwent surgery over the weekend. The Austrian, who was 18th in the season's opening giant slalom in Soelden, was forced to take a year's break from ski racing two years ago after injuring her right knee in a fall at a World Cup race in Veysonnaz, Switzerland.
